signal: Filevine raised $400M in 2025 at a $3B valuation and acquired Pincites and Parrot, scaling its AI-powered legal platform fast.

email.body1:
Jamie, saw Filevine raised $400M at a $3B valuation and is stacking AI acquisitions like Pincites and Parrot.

Growth that fast usually buries an outbound team in follow-up volume, more accounts to touch than reps can keep up with, and that is where leads go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your reps spend time in conversations, not the queue: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jamie, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Scaling an SDR team usually means ramp time and follow-up backlog before new reps hit full speed. Multi-channel done right lifts responses 287% over single channel, but only if every touch actually goes out on time.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them and how the cadence would run?
email.body3:
Jamie, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jamie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If taking follow-up volume off your reps is not a priority while you scale the team, no problem at all. Timing matters during a growth push, and I know ramping SDRs keeps a manager busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your outbound team? I will tailor it to Filevine either way.
